title: Home Affordability (28/36)
description: Given household income, other debt, cash available, and loan terms, runs the front-end and back-end debt-to-income ratios, takes the binding one, and solves by fixed 60-iteration bisection for the maximum purchase price it supports, including a rate-sensitivity stress test at plus one and plus two points.
journeys: before you talk to a lender
data_vintage: 2026 (ratios are lender convention, not statute; interest rate is user-supplied)
